summary: The City of Oceanside urges the FCC to preserve library connectivity, retain broad geographic eligibility, maintain current discount matrix, avoid duplicative funding, and keep CIPA’s library‑specific rules while limiting new network‑wide restrictions. The City of Oceanside proposes several policy changes to the FCC’s E‑Rate program, focusing on consultant certification, library support, discount evaluation, construction distinctions, and local control of online safety.
